title: C7 AlignmentRecord
description: Renamed from an earlier hand-written 'Alignment' model to match the spec's own naming. Guardrail G1 (verdict=fit REQUIRES a non-null acordRef, anti-hallucination) and the partial/misfit counterparts are encoded as if/then conditionals, which jsonschema.Draft202012Validator enforces but generated Pydantic models do NOT (see contracts/validators.py module docstring) - fixture tests and any future write path must run both.

evidenceRefs.description: Guardrail: a 'fit' verdict MUST cite a reference actually returned within that agent invocation (anti-hallucination); not schema-checkable, enforced at the agent-runtime validation ladder (Increment 6).
